facts.statement: CLK is block clock input driven by testbench.
WB_ADDR_I is input used for register selection.
facts.quote: WB_ADDR_I 5 or 3 Input Used for register selection

facts.statement: WB_DAT_I is data input and WB_DAT_O is data output.
facts.quote:
WB_DAT_I 32 or 8 Input Data input
WB_DAT_O 32 or 8 Output Data output

facts.statement: WB_WE_I WB_STB_I WB_CYC_I are control inputs and WB_ACK_O is acknowledge output.
facts.quote:
WB_WE_I 1 Input Write or read cycle selection
WB_STB_I 1 Input Specifies transfer cycle
WB_CYC_I 1 Input A bus cycle is in progress
WB_ACK_O 1 Output Acknowledge of a transfer

sequences.purpose: Drive idle known values on wishbone inputs and hold through XZ checks
Drive idle known high on srx_pad_i and hold through XZ checks
Drive idle known low on modem inputs and hold through XZ checks

hooks.purpose: Sample modem control pads for XZ
Sample INT_O for XZ and known-after-reset

What is documented active polarity and inactive level of WB_RST_I on wb_rst_i? Source states only Asynchronous Reset; reset is common UVC not shared agent.

What is documented deassert-to-configuration delay and post-deassert settle cycles for DUT outputs to reach known values? Settle window is undocumented symbolic delay requiring clock.
